Game Overview

Tuny vs Osu 2 is a adventure title where guide Tuny, the courageous robot, through a mesmerizing 2D sci-fi world filled with perilous traps and foes. Navigate eight increasingly challenging levels, master daring double jumps, and collect elusive purple cubes while dodging fierce creatures and deadly obstacles to reach each level's exit.
